storage.title: PC Monitor data is not available
storage.missing: The database does not exist yet. Install and start the collector (scripts/Install-Collector.ps1).
storage.schema_too_old: The installed collector is older than this dashboard. Reinstall the collector.
storage.schema_too_new: The database comes from a newer collector than this dashboard. Reinstall the dashboard.
storage.unreadable: The dashboard could not open the database. Check the permissions of %ProgramData%\PcMonitor.
storage.network: The dashboard did not answer. Check that the PcMonitor.Dashboard service is running.
storage.other: The dashboard answered with an error ({problem}).

source.DriverMissing: PawnIO driver missing: only CPU load is read.
source.BoardNotDetected: Board not recognised: board voltages and temperatures are not read.

trend.title: Temperature, load and power — last 10 min

empty.title: No crash recorded
empty.description: When the PC turns itself off, the crash shows up here with what happened before it.

summary.High: The evidence clearly points to this cause.
summary.Medium: The evidence leans to this cause, but others remain possible.
summary.Low: There is little evidence; this is only the most likely of the possible causes.
summary.Inconclusive: The data of this crash does not point to a cause. See below what could be checked.
summary.none: The collector has not analysed this crash yet; it does so the next time it starts.

telemetry.title: The 2 minutes before the crash
telemetry.notAtFailure: This data ends before the crash: the collector was stopped or the PC was asleep.
telemetry.none: PC Monitor has no readings for this crash.

history.buckets: minimum, mean and maximum every {minutes} min

events.user32_1074: Shutdown or restart requested by a program or user
events.user32_1076: Reason for an unexpected shutdown given

findings.thermal_critical: The CPU reached {max} °C in the 10 s before the crash: thermal shutdown zone.
findings.thermal_at_limit: The CPU sat at {avg} °C, its design limit, in the 10 s before the crash.
findings.thermal_normal: The CPU was at most {max} °C when it crashed, far from the limit.
findings.rail_out_of_tolerance: The {rail} rail reached {observed} V ({samples} readings), outside the ATX range of {min} – {max} V.
findings.rail_droop: The {rail} rail dropped to {lowest} V in the last seconds (normal: {median} V), still within range.
findings.rail_in_tolerance: The measured voltages ({rails}) were within the ATX range.
findings.load_high: The CPU was working hard: {avg}% mean load in the 10 s before the crash.
findings.load_idle: The PC was nearly idle: {avg}% mean load in the 10 s before the crash.
findings.restart_quick: It came back on {seconds} s later (by itself or with the button: Windows cannot tell).
findings.restart_stayed_off: It stayed off for {minutes} min before being turned on again.
findings.power_transition: It crashed during a power transition: {state}.
findings.whea_hardware_error: The processor or memory reported a hardware error ({sources}).
findings.whea_pcie: There was a corrected PCIe bus error: the board or slot of some device, not the CPU.
findings.power_button_long_press: The power button was held down: forced power-off.
findings.boot_early_failure: It crashed soon after power-on, before Windows' first periodic record (~40 min).
findings.telemetry_missing: PC Monitor was not recording when the PC crashed.
findings.telemetry_not_at_failure: Recording stopped before the crash (collector stopped or PC asleep): the last data is not from the moment of the crash.
findings.telemetry_too_short: The {role} was recorded too briefly before the crash to conclude anything.
findings.estimate_lower_bound: The crash time is approximate: it happened at that moment or later.
findings.sensor_unavailable: This board does not report the {role}.
findings.rail_precision: 1 reading per second and ~0.1 V steps on +12 V: very fast or small drops do not show.
findings.rail_measured_on_board: The voltage sensor sits on the board: it cannot tell the power supply from the board or the connector.
findings.whea_may_be_power: Power instability also causes hardware errors: this does not rule out the power supply or the board.
findings.unknown: Finding "{code}": update the dashboard to see its explanation.
